title: GASP Adapter
description: Maps a business's data warehouse to the canonical GASP vocabulary. Each GASP field belongs to one or more datasets (logical tables). Map a table to each dataset you have and a column to each field, then validate to see which GASP metrics you can compute.

version.description: Adapter schema version. 1.1 adds datasets and per-field metadata.

warehouse.description: Warehouse platform (e.g. snowflake, bigquery, postgres, redshift, databricks)

_instructions.description: Free text for template guidance; ignored by tools

metricOwners.description: Who in your organization owns each metric definition. Recommended for every metric you report; the validator lists metrics without an owner.

datasets.description: Warehouse table behind each GASP dataset, as schema.table. Optional: when absent, the validator infers the table from the warehouseRef prefix shared by the dataset's mapped fields, and reports datasets whose fields point at different tables.

mappings.description: One entry per GASP field you can map. Unmapped fields may be omitted or left with an empty warehouseRef; the validator reports which metrics are covered.

metricOwner.description: Declares who owns the definition of a metric: the person or team that resolves disputes about how it is calculated.

metric.description: Metric name or formula id (e.g. 'NRR', 'nrr', 'Pipeline Value'), or 'All Core Metrics'

team.description: The team that owns this metric definition

contact.description: Optional contact person: email, Slack handle or name

gaspField.description: Canonical GASP field id (e.g. 'customer_id', 'mrr', 'event_type'). Must match a field in the GASP ontology.

dataset.description: GASP dataset this mapping applies to. Fields that live on several datasets (customer_id, snapshot_date, event_date) need one mapping per dataset you use; a mapping without dataset applies to every dataset of the field.

warehouseRef.description: Your warehouse column, as schema.table.column or as a bare column name when the dataset's table is declared under datasets. Leave empty for fields you have not mapped yet.

transform.description: Optional SQL expression applied to the column so the value matches GASP semantics, including mapping your enum values onto GASP's. Use {{value}} for the column.
examples: CASE WHEN {{value}} = 'Won' THEN 'closed_won' WHEN {{value}} = 'Lost' THEN 'closed_lost' ELSE 'open' END

owner.description: Optional owner of this field's data quality

type.description: GASP type of the field (informational, copied from the ontology)

datasets.description: GASP datasets the field belongs to (informational, copied from the ontology)

values.description: Declared enum values the mapped column must produce after transform (informational, copied from the ontology)

usedBy.description: Metrics whose formulas reference this field (informational)
